RAN4 has sent an LS to RAN1 regarding the Tx switching enhancement for 2 configured UL bands in Rel-19 TEI [1]. In RAN4#114bis meeting, three scenarios of UL Tx switching have been discussed. RAN4 brought questions on introducing UL Tx switching functionalities for scenarios 1, and whether to support scenario 1a and/or scenario 2 in Rel-19 TEI. The content of the LS is listed as below. In this contribution, we provide our views on the switching cases of each scenario and RAN1 spec impact of introducing UL Tx switching functionalities for 3Tx/4Tx UE capabilities.

[CR CR0491 for 38.214] Reason for change: Introduction of specification support for UL Tx Switching across up to 4 bands Summary of change: In clauses 6.1.6 and 6.1.6.2.2 (new), introduced UE procedures to support the uplink switching with 3 or 4 bands. Consequences if not approved: Incomplete specification support for Rel-18 UL Tx switching across up to 4 bands

In this contribution, we provide our views on UL Tx switching cases for 3Tx UE in scenario 1, scenario 1a and 4Tx UE in scenario 2. The proposals are provided in below. Proposal 1: The switching cases for 3Tx UEs configured with uplinkTxSwitchingOption set to ‘dualUL’ can be captured in TS38.214 Section 6.1.6.2.0. Proposal 2: From RAN1 perspective, it is possible to support scenario 1a and/or scenario 2 in Rel-19 as part of TEI-19.
